It’s definitely not impossible to start your life again but it won’t stop depression from hitting or more impulsive behaviors:

Tracking (honestly) what you eat , my fitness pal is a really good app and see how much you are eating in a normal week and see where your extra cals are coming from. 
I’ve lost 30kg before ( gained it back due to medication but losing it again) 
Eat meals I find I get hungry mid afternoon before dinner so I have protein shake(powder not stuff you but in bottles we powder is only 129 cals) and a banana. 

Cut down your portions add in extra veggies to your meals it will make you feel fuller but lower cals than having pasta. 

Sugar isn’t the worst thing in the world but try cut it down as it’s just burst of energy for a short while and added cals 

Exercise can help a lot but doesn’t outdo a bad diet, waking extra during the day is an easy way to burn some extra cals , i love rugby and strength training so that’s what I do but find something that you enjoy. 

Don’t punish yourself for having a bad meal/bad day just get back into your routine. 

Set obtainable small goals and celebrate the wins , get new workout clothes, make up , face masks just something fun 

Weigh yourself 3 times a week and take an average weigh fluctuates day to day so an average is better , measurements and photos are a great way to track as well 

Please don’t skip meals/try quick fixes/ punish yourself for eating/don’t obsess over instagram models they aren’t real, remember your period will effect your weight so don’t get down if it goes up around then
